record.what_it_does: White-label payment gateway (NMI platform) reached via merchant API keys; the Paygent Connect product itself is unconfirmed.
record.auth_notes: This describes NMI's API, not a confirmed Paygent Connect API. v5 takes a private or public security key in the Authorization header. Classic APIs take api_key in the body. Keys come from Merchant or Partner Portal > Settings > Security Keys and inherit the permissions of the user they are tied to. Merchant Sign-Up for partners uses an OAuth-style token that expires after 60 minutes. Each end user would have to supply their own merchant key.
record.access_notes: Keys require an NMI gateway merchant account, or a partner account for sign-up flows. Whether a free sandbox account is self-serve was not confirmed. A Paygent-branded account would be issued by Paygent or its reseller. No Paygent-specific docs were found.
record.api_breadth_notes: NMI covers the Payment API (v5 and classic), Customer Vault, recurring billing, merchant applications and sign-up, webhook subscriptions, settlements, chargebacks and ACH. The breadth is inferred from doc navigation, not counted.
record.mcp_notes: NMI hosts an MCP server, documented on its MCP Server page at docs.nmi.com. It only lets coding assistants query the NMI docs. It does not call the payments API. Nothing was found for Paygent.
record.blocker_notes: The "Paygent Connect" identity is unverified, and no Paygent developer docs turned up. If it is an NMI white-label, a toolkit would work against the NMI API with per-merchant keys. The NMI gateway account is required, and its sandbox terms are unclear.

evidence.quote: Send your API key in the request header (Authorization: YOUR_API_KEY)
Webhook Subscriptions let you create, list, update, and delete subscriptions through the API.
A hosted MCP server lets AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Cursor, and VS Code query the NMI docs directly.

record.needs_human: The product identity is unconfirmed. Searches found no "Paygent Connect" page, and nothing linking Paygent to NMI. Paygent could also mean the Japanese Paygent PSP, which has its own API. Someone should confirm which product is meant, and how a Paygent-branded NMI account is provisioned (sandbox signup, fees). Also confirm whether NMI publishes an OpenAPI spec.
